newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Serfin starts Apasco hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Serfin starts Apasco hold.

text.p: --Grupo Financiero Serfin initiated coverage of Apasco with a hold recommendation.
--Analyst Gerardo Saenz estimates EPS at 3.35 pesos for 1996 and 3.48 pesos in 1997.
--Says company should be among "prime beneficiaries" from recovery of construction sector expected in the second half of next year.
--Price objective of 69 to 75 pesos set for the end of 1996, 90 to 99 pesos for end of 1997.
--Apasco has improved network of terminals to meet demand and has reduced transport times.
--Greater exports to Malaysia, Indonesia and Philippines seen.
